subject: Intermittent timeout on 34-page financial audit PDF
description: When processing a 34-page financial audit statement via the /api/v1/extract endpoint, the request intermittently times out at 30 seconds. We are using a Developer Pro key.

replies.message: When processing a 34-page financial audit statement via the /api/v1/extract endpoint, the request intermittently times out at 30 seconds.

Thanks for reporting this Alex. On documents over 30 pages, multi-threaded CPU page batching can exceed the default 30s gateway timeout if table matrix clustering is enabled. We have increased worker concurrency. Could you provide the job ID so we can verify the Docling layout logs?

subject: Helm chart MinIO cluster credential configuration question
description: Deploying the air-gapped Helm chart in an offline Kubernetes cluster. We need to point worker pods to an internal MinIO S3 bucket without internet egress.

replies.message: Deploying the air-gapped Helm chart in an offline Kubernetes cluster. We need to point worker pods to an internal MinIO S3 bucket without internet egress.

Resolved. In values.yaml, set minio.s3_endpoint_url: 'http://minio.storage.svc:9000' and enable s3_force_path_style: true. The OCR engine will stream entirely over cluster-internal networking with zero external DNS lookups.
Ticket marked as Resolved by Marcus Brody.

subject: Arabic & Urdu multi-column receipt character spacing
description: We are scanning retail invoices from Lahore and Karachi. Some Urdu Nastaliq headings have trailing spaces between connected glyphs.

replies.message: We are scanning retail invoices from Lahore and Karachi. Some Urdu Nastaliq headings have trailing spaces between connected glyphs.

Escalated to S1. RapidOCR's Arabic text line clusterer was splitting ligatures when font size fell below 9pt. We have patched the character bounding box merger in extract_cli.py. A hotfix build will be released today.
